name: QCK-1 QFLOP@1MHz virtual vector raster program
semantics: Each lane evaluates one deterministic virtual FP32 multiply then add (2 FLOP-equivalent operations). 500,000,000 FMA lanes are addressable per hologram epoch.
measurementBoundary: 1 QFLOP/s-eq is represented/reconstructable virtual compute at a verified 1 MHz epoch rate. It is not one quadrillion physically executed host floating-point operations per second.
